answer: Each identity anchors to one verified rented home: it files a lease plus landlord attestation, and the registry rejects a second identity at the same address. A quarterly summit of sampled landlords confirms occupancy, so a paper lease earns nothing. Each fake costs a 1,500-unit deposit plus 800 units monthly rent, at least 6,300 units over six months; the payment tide must keep flowing or weight stops, and 100 fakes cost 630,000 units. Forging a lease fails because the cheat still needs a real landlord, a real haven address, and real payments, and a failed spot check burns the weight.
